atoms.text: I want to choose a job that'll allow me to do something I really like. That's because I wish to spend every day of my life doing things that I truly enjoy. I simply don't want to hate Mondays and I don't feel like waiting for the weekend to have fun. Since I love taking pictures and editing them, I’m planning to be a photographer after graduation.

atoms.text: I'd like to find a job that'll pay me a lot of money. I don't care what type of job it is. I'm just hoping to earn as much money as possible so that I can spend it on things I like. For instance, I want to be able to buy the latest mobile phone, have a nice car and eat out at fine dining restaurants. So, I'm thinking of becoming an engineer, since it will enable my expensive lifestyle.

atoms.text: I want to find a job that is secure. It doesn't have to be an exciting job, and it doesn't need to have a high salary either. However, it should be a job that is in high demand and not likely to go away. This is due to the fact that I never want to be unemployed. Hence, I'd like to become a nurse, because it probably will always be needed.
